wikitext: [[File:Turning the Tera Tide.png|thumb|350px|Turning the Tera Tide]] '''Turning the Tera Tide''' (Japanese: ''{{j|Turning the Tera Tide}}'') is a 1-minute {{pkmn|animation|animated}} short to celebrate {{type|Water}} Pokémon throughout the month of June 2024, and a sequel to [[Bubble Beam Berry Blast]]. It was uploaded to the official American and European [[YouTube]] channels on July 9, 2024, and on the Japanese channel on July 14, 2024, on the Asian channels on July 20, 2024. ==Blurb== Our glistening hero quartet lands in hot water in Pokémon: Turning the Tera Tide! 👊🌊 Watch Piplup, Greninja, Quaxly, and...Palafin ❓🤨 ...as they encounter a Dondozo with a mucky attitude! ==Plot== After collecting some [[Sitrus Berry|Sitrus Berries]]As shown in ''[[Bubble Beam Berry Blast]]'', {{p|Palafin}}, {{p|Greninja}}, {{p|Quaxly}}, and {{p|Piplup}} walking on the edge of a river. Making sure that no one is looking, {{fd|Palafin|Hero Form}} Palafin quickly changes into its {{form|Palafin|Zero Form}}. The others are surprised to see where Palafin in the water. Suddenly, the ground starts shaking and a {{type|Ground}} {{Tera}}stallized {{p|Dondozo}} leaps out of the water, while roaring loudly. Greninja, Quaxly, and Piplup use {{m|Water Shuriken}}, {{m|Water Gun}}, and {{m|Bubble Beam}}, respectively, but this does not faze Dondozo. Palafin also uses Water Gun, but when Quaxly turns to look at it, Palafin has disappeared. Piplup is annoyed at Palafin running away, but Hero Form Palafin taps it on the shoulder and launches a {{m|Jet Punch}} at Dondozo. Together, the four {{t|Water}} Pokémon use their attacks again, and as Palafin stomps on Dondozo, its Terastallization is finally broken. As Dondozo is confused to where it is, Quaxly feeds it a Sitrus Berry. Piplup notices Hero Form Palafin has disappeared once again to its annoyance, while Zero Form Palafin splashes around in the water. ==Characters== ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Palafin}} ({{fd|Palafin|Hero Form}}, {{fd|Palafin|Zero Form}}) * {{p|Greninja}} * {{p|Quaxly}} * {{p|Piplup}} * {{p|Dondozo}} ({{Tera}}stallized) ==Video== {{YouTubeEmbed|PyYrKBDZQkE|Pokemon|name=The Official Pokémon YouTube channel|Water}} ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{Water color}}|bordercolor={{Water color dark}} |en=Turning the Tera Tide 👊🌊 |ja={{j|Turning the Tera Tide}} |fr=Oh la cata ! 👊🌊 |de=Mit allen Wassern gewaschen 👊🌊 |it=uno per tutti tra i flutti 👊🌊 |es_eu=Buena onda 👊🌊 |es_la=Buena Onda 👊🌊 |pt=Virando a Maré 👊🌊 |zh_cmn=力挽太晶瀾 |id=Turning the Tera Tide 👊🌊 |th=Turning the Tera Tide 👊🌊 }} ==Notes== {{reflist|group=lower-alpha}} ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== * Video ** English ([https://youtu.be/PyYrKBDZQkE International], [https://youtu.be/mU4xSYpgEss Asia]) ** [https://youtu.be/zmOzMNLGs4k Japanese] ** [https://youtu.be/celJLo5sgrY Mandarin Chinese (Taiwan)] ** [https://youtu.be/n2ntdN2Q0Ns French] ** [https://youtu.be/uJJCHDg_ie8 German] ** [https://youtu.be/oYNXwIkZamA Indonesian] ** [https://youtu.be/uJJCHDg_ie8 Italian] ** [https://youtu.be/8gYzfJVox8g Portuguese] ** Spanish ([https://youtu.be/8gYzfJVox8g Europe], [https://youtu.be/c6WHvsZ4qwU Latin America]) ** [https://youtu.be/WdHUf2vkojM Thai] {{Project Anime notice}} [[Category:Animation]]
